# Virtual Ivy Consultancy

> Virtual Ivy Consultancy is an HR consulting, recruitment and HR outsourcing firm based in Nairobi, Kenya, serving startups, SMEs, NGOs and corporate organisations across Kenya and East Africa. We help growing businesses build compliant, high-performing teams without the cost of a full in-house HR department, with deep expertise in Kenyan labour law (Employment Act 2007, PAYE, NSSF, SHIF and the Affordable Housing Levy). Contact: hello@virtualivy.net, +254 723 828 190.

## Services
- [HR Consulting in Kenya](https://virtualivy.co.ke/hr-consulting-kenya): Senior, on-demand HR advisory, audits, policies and strategy for organisations across Kenya.
- [Recruitment Services in Kenya](https://virtualivy.co.ke/recruitment-services-kenya): End-to-end hiring, job design, sourcing, screening, structured interviews and background checks.
- [Talent Acquisition in Kenya](https://virtualivy.co.ke/talent-acquisition-kenya): Strategic, pipeline-based hiring, headhunting and executive search.
- [HR Outsourcing in Kenya](https://virtualivy.co.ke/hr-outsourcing-services-kenya): Your HR function outsourced, onboarding, records, leave, payroll support and employee relations.
- [HR Compliance in Kenya](https://virtualivy.co.ke/hr-compliance-kenya): Contracts, policies and payroll aligned to the Employment Act 2007 and statutory requirements.
- [Labour Law Compliance in Kenya](https://virtualivy.co.ke/labour-law-compliance-kenya): Practical guidance on Kenyan employment law, disputes, discipline and termination.
- [People Operations in Kenya](https://virtualivy.co.ke/people-operations-kenya): Day-to-day HR administration, onboarding, records and employee relations.
- [HR Strategy in Kenya](https://virtualivy.co.ke/hr-strategy-kenya): Workforce planning, organisational design and performance management.
- [Employee Relations in Kenya](https://virtualivy.co.ke/employee-relations-kenya): Grievances, discipline, investigations and engagement.
- [Organizational Development in Kenya](https://virtualivy.co.ke/organizational-development-kenya): Structure, culture and change management.
- [Startup HR Services in Kenya](https://virtualivy.co.ke/startup-hr-services-kenya): HR foundations for early-stage and scaling startups.
- [NGO HR Services in Kenya](https://virtualivy.co.ke/ngo-hr-services-kenya): Donor-ready, compliant HR for NGOs and development organisations.

## Guides and Insights
- [The Ultimate Guide to HR for Kenyan SMEs](https://virtualivy.co.ke/hr-guide-for-kenyan-smes): Complete HR foundation for a Kenyan small business, contracts, compliance, payroll, hiring and people ops.
- [Employment Contracts in Kenya](https://virtualivy.co.ke/employment-contracts-kenya): Essential clauses for a compliant contract under the Employment Act 2007.
- [Kenya Payroll: PAYE, NSSF, SHIF and the Housing Levy](https://virtualivy.co.ke/kenya-payroll-paye-nssf-shif): What every Kenyan employer must deduct and remit.
- [How to Terminate an Employee Legally in Kenya](https://virtualivy.co.ke/terminating-employee-kenya): Valid reasons, fair procedure, notice and avoiding unfair dismissal.
- [Redundancy in Kenya: The Correct Legal Procedure](https://virtualivy.co.ke/redundancy-procedure-kenya): Notice, fair selection, consultation and final dues.
- [HR Policies Every Kenyan Business Needs](https://virtualivy.co.ke/hr-policies-kenya): The essential policies that protect your business.
- [The True Cost of a Bad Hire in Kenya](https://virtualivy.co.ke/cost-of-bad-hire-kenya): Why a wrong hire costs far more than salary, and how to avoid it.
- [How to Conduct an HR Audit in Kenya](https://virtualivy.co.ke/hr-audit-kenya): A practical checklist for contracts, policies, payroll and compliance.
- [Maternity and Paternity Leave in Kenya](https://virtualivy.co.ke/maternity-paternity-leave-kenya): Entitlements (90 days maternity, 14 days paternity), pay and employer obligations.
- [Casual vs Permanent Employees in Kenya](https://virtualivy.co.ke/casual-vs-permanent-employees-kenya): The difference and the legal risk of misclassifying staff.
- [New NSSF Rates in Kenya 2026](https://virtualivy.co.ke/nssf-rates-kenya-2026): The February 2026 Tier I/II limits, maximum contributions (KES 6,480 employee, matched), and what employers must remit.
- [Probation Periods in Kenya](https://virtualivy.co.ke/probation-period-kenya): Maximum six months, seven days' notice, which statutory rights still apply during probation.
- [Kenya's Disability Employment Quota](https://virtualivy.co.ke/disability-employment-quota-kenya): Employers with 20+ staff must reserve at least 5% of roles for persons with disabilities.
- [Minimum Wage in Kenya 2026](https://virtualivy.co.ke/minimum-wage-kenya-2026): New rates from 1 May 2026 (12% general increase) by location, plus the 15% housing allowance rule.
- [The Affordable Housing Levy in Kenya](https://virtualivy.co.ke/affordable-housing-levy-kenya): 1.5% employee + 1.5% employer, remitted to KRA by the 9th; penalties for late payment.
- [SHIF Explained for Employers](https://virtualivy.co.ke/shif-explained-employers-kenya): SHIF replaced NHIF, 2.75% of gross (minimum KES 300), employee-only, tax-deductible.
